observations.behavior: Adds a new configuration option, CDP_HOG_FLOW_BATCH_AUDIENCE_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS, to the shared CommonConfig and its default implementation.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the batch workflow resolver to use a larger timeout for audience fetching, which is necessary because ClickHouse queries for audience resolution routinely exceed the standard 3s inter-service budget.

observations.behavior: Updates the HogFlowBatchPersonQueryService constructor to accept the audience fetch timeout and passes it to the internal fetch service.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the batch workflow's audience fetching to the new timeout configuration, allowing the service to respect the configured budget.

observations.behavior: Adds a heartbeat timeout and batch size configuration to the HogFlow batch resolve worker, using the audience fetch timeout plus a 30s headroom.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents worker starvation or unresponsive peers by setting a heartbeat timeout that accounts for the audience fetch duration, while also constraining batch size to avoid processing bottlenecks.
